patch.title: Collective sells at the $99 Founding price under $149 list, and the owner confirms the ladder in production

append.detail: RE-PRICED 2026-10-19 (ADR-1750). PREMISE RE-TESTED on main and in production: the catalog carried collective_base as $149 list over $99 founding and Stripe held both prices, but every surface collapsed founding to list after the 2026-08-17 cutover, so the checkout billed $149 and the grid quoted $149 flat while the help centre and template said $99. Owner ruling 2026-10-19: Collective is $149 with a $99 intro. Code: FOUNDING_OPEN_ITEMS and foundingOpenFor in lib/pricing/beta.ts hold the Collective intro open per item; the checkout, ladder, grid, pricing table and comparison read it; settings.ts derives plan.collective from the catalog and ignores the stale pricing_settings row; FOUNDING_RATE_NOTE is the one caption; Collective copy is the partner hub, Network is chapters, the ladder is six tiers. Still open for the owner: confirm https://frequencylocal.com/pricing shows Collective at $99/mo with $149 struck and the Founding caption, and the Business and Collective checkouts end to end.
